description:
Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least three charge counters on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array three times by removing three charge counters from it, adding {2}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Tromell.
Repeat.
